note: Federal fiscal indicators. Sources: OMB Historical Tables (historic FY data), Treasury Fiscal Data, CBO baselines. Negative deficit = surplus. FY = fiscal year (ends Sept 30). FY2025 values verified ($1.8T deficit, 5.8% of GDP; net interest $970B = 3.2% of GDP; debt held by public ~100% of GDP). Projections: CBO Feb 2026 baseline — FY2026 deficit $1.9T, debt held by public 120% of GDP by 2036; CBO long-term (Mar 2026): ~175% of GDP by mid-2050s. Quality: HIGH for verified/recent; MEDIUM for historical benchmarks (minor revisions).

debt_held_by_public_pct_gdp.note: End of fiscal year. 1945-1946 WWII peak ~100-106%; fell to ~24-27% by mid-1970s; rising since 1981 (26%→39% under Reagan); fell to 32.5% (2001) under Clinton; 53% (2009) GWB; 61% (2010) Obama peak; ~100% (2021); ~99-100% (2024-2025).

deficit_pct_gdp.note: FY2025 -5.8% verified. WWII deficits to -30% (FY1943). FY2000 surplus +2.3%.

net_interest_pct_gdp.note: FY2025 = 3.2% ($970B) verified. Interest as % of revenue FY2025 ≈ 19%; as % of outlays ≈ 13.8%. CBO: net interest doubles to ~$2.1T (~4.6% of GDP) by FY2035.

revenue_pct_gdp.note: Historical band ~15-20.5%. Peaks: FY2000 20.6%, FY2022 19.7% (inflation+growth). Troughs: FY2009 15.1% (crisis). FY2024 17.3%.

outlays_pct_gdp.note: FY2025 23.3% verified ($7.0T). Peace-time norm ~20-21%; crisis years to 25%+.

mandatory_vs_discretionary_share.note: Structural shift: mandatory (SS, Medicare, Medicaid, income security, interest) ~62-65%; discretionary ~25-28% (defense ~12-13%, non-defense ~12-15%); interest ~13-14% (rising).

debt_accumulation_by_administration_tril.unit: $T increase in gross federal debt during tenure (approx)
debt_accumulation_by_administration_tril.note: GROSS DEBT Δ — attribution requires care (root Section 5): includes inherited crises, wars, recessions, interest. Not a 'president caused this' measure.

reagan.note: Tax cuts + defense + interest; debt/GDP public 26%→39%

bush41.note: S&L cleanup, recession, 1990 tax increase insufficient

bush43.note: Tax cuts, wars, Medicare Part D, 2001 & 2007-09 recessions, crisis; debt/GDP 32.5%→53% (public)

obama.note: GFC response (ARRA, TARP), lost revenue from crisis, ACA; deficits fell from 9.8% to 3.2%; debt/GDP 53%→77% (public)

biden.note: ARP + IRA/CHIPS/Infrastructure + high interest rates; deficit fell 12.4%→6.4%; debt/GDP flat ~99-100% (public)

trump2.note: INCOMPLETE. OBBBA adds ~$3.4T to 10-yr deficits (CBO); FY2025 deficit $1.8T

tax_bill_scores_trillions.note: Conventional (static) CBO/JCT scores; 'dynamic' estimates typically recover a small fraction. None of these bills was scored as self-financing by CBO/JCT.

ERTA_1981.note: Reagan 1981; revenue loss ~$750B over 1981-86 window in then-dollars (JCT); effective top rate 70%→50%

TRA_1986.note: Bipartisan reform; revenue-neutral on paper; broadened base, cut top rate to 28%

OBBBA_2025.note: CBO: net +$3.4T FY2025-34 unified deficit (incl. making TCJA permanent +$858B); Tax Foundation revenue effect -$5.2T; CRFB: +$2.4T primary, +$3.0T debt
